description:
"Charge you and your grouped allies' weapons with volcanic power to gain Major Brutality and Sorcery, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff30|r seconds.

While active, dealing damage with Light and Heavy Attacks causes an additional |cffffff1562|r Flame Damage, up to once every |cffffff1.5|r seconds.

You also gain Empower for the duration, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by |cffffff70|r%."
